name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx as a multi-site web server for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static test, CI, and status content, along with related host-security controls.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis as local caching services, configuring Redis on port 6379 with password authentication.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub, including Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, a virtual environment, database and user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
